title: iNaturalist
organization: iNaturalist (California Academy of Sciences & National Geographic Society)
description: A free, nonprofit, community-powered biodiversity platform where anyone can photograph and log wild organisms; an AI-assisted identification system and a global network of naturalists help confirm species, and research-grade observations feed directly into scientific datasets used by working biologists. Over 550,000 species have been documented by the community to date. No application, fee, or prior training required.
current_cycle_label: Ongoing — no enrollment window, contribute anytime

title: Winship Summer Scholars Program (Virtual Track)
description: A 6-week cancer-research program for rising or graduating high school seniors, offering hands-on exposure to oncology research under Winship Cancer Institute mentorship. The virtual track — unlike Winship's in-person track, which is restricted to U.S. citizens/permanent residents — is explicitly open to applicants regardless of citizenship or residency status, and pays a $2,400 stipend rather than charging a fee.
cost: Free to attend — pays a $2,400 stipend for the 6-week virtual track
citizenship_restrictions: None for the virtual track specifically (the separate in-person track requires U.S. citizenship or permanent residency; the virtual track does not)
